requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header in the PUBREL Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: For every PUBREL Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Fixed-header bits 3, 2, 1, and 0 must equal 0, 0, 1, and 0 respectively.
requirements.why_checkable: The low nibble of PUBREL fixed-header byte 1 can be compared with binary 0010.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection [MQTT-3.6.1-1].
requirements.condition: When a PUBREL Packet has fixed-header bits 3 through 0 other than 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the PUBREL Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Each alternate low-nibble value can be injected and the malformed-packet handling path observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection [MQTT-3.6.1-1].
requirements.condition: When a PUBREL Packet has fixed-header bits 3 through 0 other than 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue the connection after detecting the invalid PUBREL flags.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid low nibble can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: This is the length of the variable header.
requirements.condition: When computing Remaining Length for PUBREL
requirements.required_behavior: Remaining Length must equal the PUBREL variable-header byte length.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded variable-header length can be compared with Remaining Length.

requirements.quote: For the PUBREL Packet this has the value 2.
requirements.condition: For the PUBREL Remaining Length field
requirements.required_behavior: The value must be exactly 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded Remaining Length can be asserted as two.

requirements.quote: The variable header contains the same Packet Identifier as the PUBREC Packet that is being acknowledged.
requirements.condition: When PUBREL acknowledges a PUBREC Packet
requirements.required_behavior: PUBREL must carry the same Packet Identifier as that PUBREC.
requirements.why_checkable: The Packet Identifier fields of the paired PUBREC and PUBREL can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	Packet Identifier MSB
byte 2	Packet Identifier LSB
requirements.condition: For the PUBREL variable-header Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: Byte 1 must contain the Packet Identifier most significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The first variable-header byte can be correlated with the high byte of the decoded identifier.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	Packet Identifier MSB
byte 2	Packet Identifier LSB
requirements.condition: For the PUBREL variable-header Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: Byte 2 must contain the Packet Identifier least significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The second variable-header byte can be correlated with the low byte of the decoded identifier.

requirements.quote: The PUBREL Packet has no payload.
requirements.condition: For every PUBREL Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must contain no payload bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: PUBREL must not carry a payload.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet boundary can be checked after its two-byte variable header.

requirements.quote: The PUBCOMP Packet is the response to a PUBREL Packet.
requirements.condition: When a PUBCOMP Packet is sent
requirements.required_behavior: It must be the response to a PUBREL Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A QoS 2 exchange trace can correlate each PUBCOMP with its preceding PUBREL.

requirements.quote: It is the fourth and final packet of the QoS 2 protocol exchange.
requirements.condition: For a QoS 2 protocol exchange
requirements.required_behavior: PUBCOMP must be the fourth packet in the exchange.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet sequence in a complete QoS 2 exchange can be counted and decoded.

requirements.quote: It is the fourth and final packet of the QoS 2 protocol exchange.
requirements.condition: After PUBCOMP is sent in a QoS 2 protocol exchange
requirements.required_behavior: That QoS 2 protocol exchange must be complete.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The same exchange must not require a fifth protocol packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The exchange can be observed to terminate after PUBCOMP.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	MQTT Control Packet type (7)	Reserved
	0	1	1	1	0	0	0	0
requirements.condition: For every PUBCOMP Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Bits 7 through 4 of fixed-header byte 1 must encode Control Packet type 7 as 0111.
requirements.why_checkable: The high nibble of the first PUBCOMP byte can be compared with 0111.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	MQTT Control Packet type (7)	Reserved
	0	1	1	1	0	0	0	0
requirements.condition: For every PUBCOMP Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Reserved bits 3 through 0 of fixed-header byte 1 must be 0000.
requirements.why_checkable: The low nibble of the first PUBCOMP byte can be masked and compared with zero.

requirements.quote:
byte 2	Remaining Length (2)
	0	0	0	0	0	0	1	0
requirements.condition: For every PUBCOMP Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Fixed-header byte 2 must encode Remaining Length as 2 (0x02).
requirements.why_checkable: The second PUBCOMP byte can be compared directly with 0x02.

requirements.quote: This is the length of the variable header.
requirements.condition: When computing Remaining Length for PUBCOMP
requirements.required_behavior: Remaining Length must equal the PUBCOMP variable-header byte length.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded variable-header length can be compared with Remaining Length.

requirements.quote: For the PUBCOMP Packet this has the value 2.
requirements.condition: For the PUBCOMP Remaining Length field
requirements.required_behavior: The value must be exactly 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded Remaining Length can be asserted as two.

requirements.quote: The variable header contains the same Packet Identifier as the PUBREL Packet that is being acknowledged.
requirements.condition: When PUBCOMP acknowledges a PUBREL Packet
requirements.required_behavior: PUBCOMP must carry the same Packet Identifier as that PUBREL.
requirements.why_checkable: The Packet Identifier fields of the paired PUBREL and PUBCOMP can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	Packet Identifier MSB
byte 2	Packet Identifier LSB
requirements.condition: For the PUBCOMP variable-header Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: Byte 1 must contain the Packet Identifier most significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The first variable-header byte can be correlated with the high byte of the decoded identifier.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	Packet Identifier MSB
byte 2	Packet Identifier LSB
requirements.condition: For the PUBCOMP variable-header Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: Byte 2 must contain the Packet Identifier least significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The second variable-header byte can be correlated with the low byte of the decoded identifier.

requirements.quote: The PUBCOMP Packet has no payload.
requirements.condition: For every PUBCOMP Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must contain no payload bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: PUBCOMP must not carry a payload.
requirements.why_checkable: The packet boundary can be checked after its two-byte variable header.

requirements.quote: The SUBSCRIBE Packet is sent from the Client to the Server to create one or more Subscriptions.
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Packet is sent
requirements.required_behavior: It must travel from the Client to the Server.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not originate SUBSCRIBE toward a Client.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet type, sender role, and receiver role can be observed on the connection.

requirements.quote: The SUBSCRIBE Packet is sent from the Client to the Server to create one or more Subscriptions.
requirements.condition: When a Client constructs or a Server decodes a SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must represent a request to create one or more Subscriptions.
requirements.why_checkable: The payload can be parsed to confirm that it requests at least one Subscription without assuming that every request is granted.

requirements.quote: Each Subscription registers a Client’s interest in one or more Topics.
requirements.condition: For every Subscription created from SUBSCRIBE
requirements.required_behavior: It must register the Client’s interest in at least one Topic.
requirements.why_checkable: A created Subscription can be exercised against Topic Names to confirm it denotes one or more Topics.

requirements.quote: The Server sends PUBLISH Packets to the Client in order to forward Application Messages that were published to Topics that match these Subscriptions.
requirements.condition: When an Application Message's Topic matches a Client Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must use a PUBLISH Packet to forward the Application Message to that Client.
requirements.why_checkable: A matching Subscription and publication can be created and the forwarded packet type and recipient observed.

requirements.quote: The SUBSCRIBE Packet also specifies (for each Subscription) the maximum QoS with which the Server can send Application Messages to the Client.
requirements.condition: For each Subscription represented in SUBSCRIBE
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must specify that Subscription's maximum delivery QoS.
requirements.why_checkable: Each Topic Filter entry can be correlated with an accompanying Requested QoS byte.

requirements.quote:
Bit	7	6	5	4	3	2	1	0
byte 1	MQTT Control Packet type (8)	Reserved
	1	0	0	0	0	0	1	0
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Bits 7 through 4 of fixed-header byte 1 must encode Control Packet type 8 as 1000.
requirements.why_checkable: The high nibble of the first SUBSCRIBE byte can be compared with 1000.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the SUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Fixed-header bits 3, 2, 1, and 0 must equal 0, 0, 1, and 0 respectively.
requirements.why_checkable: The low nibble of SUBSCRIBE fixed-header byte 1 can be compared with binary 0010.

requirements.quote: byte 2	Remaining Length
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The Remaining Length field must begin at fixed-header byte 2.
requirements.why_checkable: A decoder can assert the starting byte of Remaining Length.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection [MQTT-3.8.1-1].
requirements.condition: When SUBSCRIBE fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Each alternate low-nibble value can be injected and malformed-packet handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection [MQTT-3.8.1-1].
requirements.condition: When SUBSCRIBE fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue the connection after detecting invalid SUBSCRIBE flags.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid low nibble can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: This is the length of variable header (2 bytes) plus the length of the payload.
requirements.condition: When computing Remaining Length for SUBSCRIBE
requirements.required_behavior: Remaining Length must equal 2 plus the SUBSCRIBE payload length in bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded value can be compared with the two-byte variable header plus observed payload size.

requirements.quote: The variable header contains a Packet Identifier.
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The variable header must contain a Packet Identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: The two-byte variable header can be decoded for Packet Identifier presence.

requirements.quote: The payload of a SUBSCRIBE Packet contains a list of Topic Filters indicating the Topics to which the Client wants to subscribe.
requirements.condition: For a SUBSCRIBE Packet payload
requirements.required_behavior: The payload must represent its subscription requests as a list of Topic Filters.
requirements.why_checkable: The payload can be parsed as repeated Topic Filter entries.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters in a SUBSCRIBE packet payload MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3 [MQTT-3.8.3-1].
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: The Topic Filter must be encoded as an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.why_checkable: The length prefix and string bytes can be decoded and validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: A Server SHOULD support Topic filters that contain the wildcard characters defined in Section 4.7.1.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter contains a wildcard character defined by Section 4.7.1
requirements.required_behavior: The Server should support that wildcard-containing Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: The exact wildcard character set and its matching semantics are only referenced and are not supplied in this chunk, so a complete test cannot be derived from this evidence alone.

requirements.quote: If it chooses not to support topic filters that contain wildcard characters it MUST reject any Subscription request whose filter contains them [MQTT-3.8.3-2].
requirements.condition: If the Server chooses not to support wildcard-containing Topic Filters and receives such a Subscription request
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must reject the Subscription request.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not accept the unsupported wildcard Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: With wildcard support disabled, a parser-recognized wildcard filter can be submitted and the acceptance outcome observed.

requirements.quote: Each filter is followed by a byte called the Requested QoS.
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter in the SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Exactly one Requested QoS byte must immediately follow the filter.
requirements.why_checkable: A payload parser can identify the Topic Filter boundary and the next byte.

requirements.quote: This gives the maximum QoS level at which the Server can send Application Messages to the Client.
requirements.condition: For the Requested QoS byte following a Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: Its value must represent the maximum QoS at which the Server may send matching Application Messages to the Client.
requirements.why_checkable: The granted delivery QoS can be compared with the Requested QoS associated with that filter.

requirements.quote: The payload of a SUBSCRIBE packet MUST contain at least one Topic Filter / QoS pair.
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The payload must contain one or more Topic Filter/Requested QoS pairs.
requirements.why_checkable: The repeated pair count can be computed after parsing the payload.

requirements.quote: A SUBSCRIBE packet with no payload is a protocol violation [MQTT-3.8.3-3].
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Packet has no payload
requirements.required_behavior: The receiver must classify it as a protocol violation.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat the empty-payload SUBSCRIBE as a protocol violation.
requirements.why_checkable: An empty-payload SUBSCRIBE can be injected and the protocol-violation path observed.

requirements.quote: The requested maximum QoS field is encoded in the byte following each UTF-8 encoded topic name, and these Topic Filter / QoS pairs are packed contiguously.
requirements.condition: For each UTF-8 encoded Topic Filter in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: The Requested QoS field must occupy the byte immediately following that string.
requirements.why_checkable: The UTF-8 string length determines the exact expected offset of its Requested QoS byte.

requirements.quote: The requested maximum QoS field is encoded in the byte following each UTF-8 encoded topic name, and these Topic Filter / QoS pairs are packed contiguously.
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE payload contains multiple Topic Filter/Requested QoS pairs
requirements.required_behavior: The pairs must be packed contiguously without intervening fields or padding.
requirements.why_checkable: The end offset of each pair can be compared with the start offset of the next pair.

requirements.quote:
Topic Filter
byte 1	Length MSB
byte 2	Length LSB
bytes 3..N	Topic Filter
requirements.condition: For each Topic Filter entry in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Entry byte 1 must contain the Topic Filter length most significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The first entry byte can be correlated with the high byte of the decoded string length.

requirements.quote:
Topic Filter
byte 1	Length MSB
byte 2	Length LSB
bytes 3..N	Topic Filter
requirements.condition: For each Topic Filter entry in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Entry byte 2 must contain the Topic Filter length least significant byte.
requirements.why_checkable: The second entry byte can be correlated with the low byte of the decoded string length.

requirements.quote:
Topic Filter
byte 1	Length MSB
byte 2	Length LSB
bytes 3..N	Topic Filter
requirements.condition: For each Topic Filter entry in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Entry bytes 3 through N must contain the Topic Filter string bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The two-byte length prefix determines the exact Topic Filter byte interval.

requirements.quote:
Requested QoS
	Reserved	QoS
byte N+1	0	0	0	0	0	0	X	X
requirements.condition: For each Topic Filter entry ending at byte N
requirements.required_behavior: The Requested QoS byte must occupy byte N+1.
requirements.why_checkable: The string boundary determines the expected byte index of Requested QoS.

requirements.quote: The upper 6 bits of the Requested QoS byte are not used in the current version of the protocol. They are reserved for future use.
requirements.condition: For every Requested QoS byte in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Bits 7 through 2 must remain reserved and be encoded as zero.
requirements.why_checkable: The Requested QoS byte can be masked with 0xFC and compared with zero; the adjacent payload-format table supplies the fixed zero values.

requirements.quote:
Requested QoS
	Reserved	QoS
byte N+1	0	0	0	0	0	0	X	X
requirements.condition: For every Requested QoS byte in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: Bits 1 and 0 must encode the Requested QoS value.
requirements.why_checkable: The QoS value can be decoded using a two-bit mask.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2 [MQTT-3-8.3-4].
requirements.condition: When any reserved bit in a SUBSCRIBE payload Requested QoS byte is nonzero
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Each reserved bit can be set in isolation and the malformed-packet path observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2 [MQTT-3-8.3-4].
requirements.condition: When any reserved bit in a SUBSCRIBE payload Requested QoS byte is nonzero
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting nonzero payload reserved bits.
requirements.why_checkable: A nonzero reserved bit can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2 [MQTT-3-8.3-4].
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Requested QoS value is not 0, 1, or 2
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: The two-bit value 3 can be injected and the malformed-packet path observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2 [MQTT-3-8.3-4].
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Requested QoS value is not 0, 1, or 2
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting the invalid Requested QoS value.
requirements.why_checkable: Requested QoS 3 can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: When the Server receives a SUBSCRIBE Packet from a Client, the Server MUST respond with a SUBACK Packet [MQTT-3.8.4-1].
requirements.condition: When the Server receives a SUBSCRIBE Packet from a Client
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must respond with SUBACK.
requirements.why_checkable: A SUBSCRIBE can be sent and the response packet type observed.

requirements.quote: The SUBACK Packet MUST have the same Packet Identifier as the SUBSCRIBE Packet that it is acknowledging [MQTT-3.8.4-2].
requirements.condition: When SUBACK acknowledges a SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: SUBACK must carry the same Packet Identifier as that SUBSCRIBE.
requirements.why_checkable: The Packet Identifiers in the request and response can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote: The Server is permitted to start sending PUBLISH packets matching the Subscription before the Server sends the SUBACK Packet.
requirements.condition: After receiving SUBSCRIBE and before sending its SUBACK
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to send PUBLISH Packets that match the new Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: The Server's packet order can be observed while SUBACK transmission is delayed.
